A negative control (flipping one assertion) confirmed the block executes rather than being skipped. Scenarios covered: initial value both states, getState, value after user click open and close, all three methods, both idempotence cases, unrecognized and absent method, trigger sync at bind including the state='open' correction, sync after server-driven open/close, two buttons plus an href anchor on one panel, an invalid-href anchor left alone and not throwing, a trigger added after bind, unsubscribe disposing the instance and silencing the panel, and re-render with the same id. The mid-transition scenario is left uncovered with a comment recording why: jsdom reports no transition duration, so shown/hidden fire synchronously and the test would pass vacuously.
